meta.name: glycoengineering
meta.description: Analyze and engineer protein glycosylation. Scan sequences for N-glycosylation sequons (N-X-S/T), predict O-glycosylation hotspots, and access curated glycoengineering tools (NetOGlyc, GlycoShield, GlycoWorkbench). For glycoprotein engineering, therapeutic antibody optimization, and vaccine design.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 分析蛋白质糖基化位点,辅助抗体与疫苗设计
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果 你在做治疗性抗体或疫苗的糖基化设计。
copy.tagline_en: Analyze protein glycosylation sites to support antibody and vaccine design.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you engineer glycosylation for therapeutic antibodies or vaccines.

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 能扫描蛋白序列中的 N-糖基化位点(N-X-S/T)、预测 O-糖基化热点、给出增删糖基化位点的突变方案,并指导使用 NetOGlyc、GlycoShield 等外部工具。
howto.when: 当需求涉及抗体工程优化、治疗性蛋白设计、疫苗抗原设计等糖基化改造,或要求扫描序列中的糖基化位点时触发。

say.text: 帮我扫描这段蛋白序列的 N-糖基化位点,并列出位置和上下文。
say.note: 会返回位点列表、motif 和前后各 3 个残基的上下文。

say.text: 去掉这段序列 297 位的 N-糖基化位点,把 N 改成 Q。
say.note: Claude 会返回突变后的序列。

say.text: 预测这段蛋白序列的 O-糖基化热点,标出可能的 S/T 位点。
say.note: 会依据局部 S/T 密度给出候选位点。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can scan protein sequences for N-glycosylation sequons (N-X-S/T), predict O-glycosylation hotspots, propose mutations to add or remove glycosites, and point to external tools such as NetOGlyc and GlycoShield.
howto.when_en: Use when requests involve antibody engineering, therapeutic protein design, vaccine antigen design, or scanning protein sequences for glycosylation sites.

say_en.text: Scan this protein sequence for N-glycosylation sequons and list positions.
Remove the N-glycosylation site at position 297 by mutating N to Q.
Predict O-glycosylation hotspots in this protein sequence.
